description.value: Securely move, manage, and transform data to power analytics, operations, and AI at scale.
An automated data movement platform that moves and models data from sources such as SaaS apps, databases, ERPs and files into warehouses and lakes.
Oakland-based automated data movement company, founded in 2012, offering a managed service that moves data from SaaS apps and databases into warehouses and cloud platforms.

product_description.value: Data movement connectors for SaaS, databases, SAP, streaming and file sources, plus custom connectors; Managed Data Lake Service delivering to Iceberg and Delta Lake; SQL-based transformations run in the destination; Activations, Hybrid Deployment, Security and Governance.

Connectors for SaaS, database, SAP, streaming and file sources; SQL transformations; Activations; Managed Data Lake Service for Iceberg and Delta Lake; Hybrid Deployment, Security, Governance and Extensibility (REST API).

A library of prebuilt connectors, fully managed ELT automation, high-volume replication and self-healing pipelines. Acquired HVR in 2021 and rebranded it as Local Data Processing for enterprise deployments.

business_model_description.value: Consumption-based pricing that charges users based on the monthly active rows processed in data pipelines.

customer_description.value: Case-study customers include Pfizer, National Australia Bank, Coke One North America, Tinuiti, Paylocity, Shutterstock, LVMH and HubSpot.

Named customers are Pfizer, National Australia Bank, Coke One North America, Tinuiti, Paylocity, Shutterstock, LVMH and HubSpot; logos under 'Trusted by' include OpenAI, Canva, Patagonia and Volkswagen.

More than 6,000 customers across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Early product-market fit came from tech start-ups in the Y Combinator network, and the company has since moved up-market into larger enterprises.

revenue.value: Surpassed $300M ARR after crossing $200M run-rate in 2023 (Komo, citing public company releases)
Revenue estimates of about $300M appear across several profiles
